_comment: Judged false positives of the seam-span NARROW rule: the record names periods either side of a break on a series it cites, IN ONE SENTENCE, but the sentence compares a DIFFERENT QUANTITY from the broken series. Each entry records what the sentence actually compares, because an id alone is an assertion and the judgement is the evidence. Frozen 2026-08-06 after reading all 21 narrow candidates. A span not in this list and not declared FAILS the gate.

entries.comparesInstead: public-sector bank aggregate loss in FY2017-18 against net profit in FY2024-25 — a profit-and-loss quantity, not the capital adequacy ratio the break sits on
Kendriya Vidyalaya contract engagements 2020-21 against 2025-26 — a staffing count, not the pupil-teacher ratio
the same KVS contract-engagement sentence, against the second break on the same series
higher-education gross enrolment ratio 2011-12 against 2023-24 — and the sentence states its own restated basis — not the UGC budget provision
debt service budgeted in BE FY2025-26 against a standing start in FY2019-20 — a financing-model change, not the gross provision series
all-India coal production FY2013-14 against FY2024-25 — the case the tool's own header names, where a series is cited for context and the years belong to a different quantity
the RANGE OF AUDIT REPORTS FY2015-16 to FY2024-25 in which the CAG makes a finding — a span of documents, not a span of values
the same audit-report range, against a second series carrying the same break
the same audit-report range, against a third series carrying the same break
the same audit-report range, against a later break on the same series

cesses and surcharges as a share of gross tax revenue, on a table laid by the Ministry of Finance — and the record's own next sentence calls it 'a third convention, differing from both cess series already in this drop'. A different series from the one the break sits on, and its basis problem is disclosed
the same Ministry of Finance table, against a later break on the same series
